\section{Introduction}

The system achieved 94.2\% accuracy on the test set using a transformer architecture.
Training was conducted on an NVIDIA A100 GPU for 48 hours.
This result surpasses the previous state-of-the-art by 3.1\% (i.e. a significant improvement).

\section{Methodology}

We employed a two-stage pipeline consisting of feature extraction and classification.
The feature extraction stage uses a pre-trained ResNet-50 backbone.
Classification is performed by a softmax layer with 10 output classes, e.g. cat, dog, bird.

\section{Results}

Table \ref{tab:results} shows the comparison across baseline models.
Our model (Ours) achieves 94.2\% accuracy, outperforming all baselines.
Fig.~\ref{fig:architecture} illustrates the proposed architecture.

\section{Conclusion}

We presented a novel approach for image classification.
Future work includes extending the method to video data.
